description_en: Queries the configuration details of a specified MediaConvert (MC) transcoding template group, including the group information and the list of transcoding templates
description_zh: 调用本接口查询指定MediaConvert（MC）链路转码模板组的配置详情，包括组信息和转码模板列表
name: GetMediaConvertTemplateGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the transcoding template group. Only MC transcoding template groups created by calling AddMediaConvertTemplateGroup can be queried
parameters.help_zh: 转码模板组ID。仅支持查询MC链路（通过AddMediaConvertTemplateGroup创建）的转码模板组
parameters.name: transcode_template_group_id

AppId.description_en: The application ID. Default value: app-1000000. For more information, see [Multiple applications]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html）
AppId.description_zh: 应用ID。默认取值： app-1000000。使用说明，请参见[多应用]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html）

CreationTime.description_en: The creation time. The time is displayed in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format

ModifyTime.description_en: The modification time. The time is displayed in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format

Name.description_en: The name of the transcoding template group

TemplateType.description_en: The type of the template group, which is determined by the purpose of the first template in the group. Valid values: Normal: normal transcoding template group. VideoPackage: video packaging template group
TemplateType.description_zh: 模板组类型，由组内首个模板的用途决定。取值：Normal：普通转码模板组；VideoPackage：视频打包模板组

TranscodeTemplateGroupId.description_en: The ID of the transcoding template group

TranscodeTemplateList.description_en: The list of transcoding template configurations

Audio.description_en: The transcoding parameters for the audio stream. The value is a JSON string that includes Codec, Bitrate, Samplerate, and Channels. The default value of Codec is AAC
Audio.description_zh: 音频流转码参数，JSON字符串，包括Codec（默认值：AAC）、Bitrate、Samplerate、Channels等

Container.description_en: The container format configuration. The value is a JSON string that includes Format. Valid values for Format: mp4, m3u8, and mpd
Container.description_zh: 封装容器配置，JSON字符串，包含Format（取值：mp4、m3u8、mpd）

EncryptSetting.description_en: The encryption configuration. The value is a JSON string that includes EncryptType and EncryptConfig

MuxConfig.description_en: The muxing parameters. The value is a JSON string. When you generate an m3u8 file, you can set Segment.Duration to specify the segment duration
MuxConfig.description_zh: 封装参数，JSON字符串。生成m3u8时可通过Segment.Duration设置分片时长

PackageSetting.description_en: The packaging configuration. The value is a JSON string that includes PackageType. This parameter is used for video and subtitle packaging templates
PackageSetting.description_zh: 打包配置，JSON字符串，视频/字幕打包模板使用，包含PackageType等

SubtitleList.description_en: The list of subtitle configurations. The value is a JSON string array
SubtitleList.description_zh: 字幕配置列表，JSON字符串数组

TemplateName.description_en: The name of the transcoding template

TransConfig.description_en: The general transcoding configuration. The value is a JSON string that includes TransMode and other parameters
TransConfig.description_zh: 转码通用配置，JSON字符串，包括TransMode等

TranscodeTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the transcoding template

Type.description_en: The templatetype. Valid values: Normal: normal transcoding template. VideoPackage: video packaging template. SubtitlePackage: subtitle packaging template
Type.description_zh: 模板类型。取值：Normal：普通转码模板；VideoPackage：视频打包模板；SubtitlePackage：字幕打包模板

Video.description_en: The transcoding parameters for the video stream. The value is a JSON string that includes Codec, Bitrate, Width, Height, and Fps. The default value of Codec is H.264
Video.description_zh: 视频流转码参数，JSON字符串，包括Codec（默认值：H.264）、Bitrate、Width、Height、Fps等

WatermarkIds.description_en: The list of watermark template IDs

items.description_en: The ID of the watermark template
